user.title: Add a Samsung device
user.description: Enter one local address. Samsung Local probes only known endpoints on this host.

pair.title: Pair the TV
pair.description: Fully turn on the TV first. Select Submit, then allow Samsung Local on {host} using the prompt displayed on the TV. Pairing cannot be completed while the TV is in standby.

ocf_auth.title: Authenticate the appliance
ocf_auth.description: Automatic setup makes one account-free request for Samsung's public certificate UUID. Import or manual identity modes work without that request.

legacy_auth.title: Legacy appliance credentials
legacy_auth.description: The HTTPS-8888 protocol requires an existing local device token and client certificate.

confirm.title: Confirm device
confirm.description: Add {name} ({model}) using {protocol}. {capabilities} functions were proven during setup.

error.cannot_connect: The device did not answer a supported local protocol.
error.invalid_host: Enter one valid IP address or hostname.
error.invalid_auth: The supplied local credentials are invalid.
error.tv_not_ready: The TV pairing connection failed. Fully turn on the TV, enable IP/local remote access in its connection settings, then submit again and accept the TV prompt.
error.public_identity_unavailable: The public identity could not be obtained. Use manual or imported credentials for offline setup.
error.legacy_not_supported: This legacy appliance family is not safely mapped.

abort.already_configured: This physical device is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: The device is no longer reachable.
abort.invalid_host: Discovery did not provide a usable address.

data.allow_writes_without_remote: Allow non-critical settings while Smart Control reports off

command_unsupported.message: This device does not advertise that command.

unknown_capabilities.title: New local Samsung functions detected
unknown_capabilities.description: {device} reports {count} resources that Samsung Local does not map yet. Download redacted diagnostics and attach them to a device-support issue. Unknown resources are never exposed as arbitrary write controls.
